description: This file defines the RendererFactory class responsible for creating specific renderer objects based on the type of document object in the MigraDoc RTF rendering process.

classes.name: RendererFactory
classes.description: A sealed class that creates renderer instances for different document object types in the MigraDoc RTF rendering process.

methods.name: CreateRenderer
methods.description: Creates and returns a specific renderer object based on the type of the provided DocumentObject.
